_readme.what: Playtest feedback — the DRAGONSLEEP playtest lamp, one verdict per checklist line.
_readme.fold_back: Whoever takes this (Cowork seat or code tab): broken and unclear lines become the fix list; too hard / too easy are tuning; notes are the tester's words, verbatim. Load this file back into the lamp to keep going.

items.section: 13. Round three: the cradle, rebuilt

items.section: 13. Round three: the cradle, rebuilt
items.claim: IT HOLDS: you jerk back, the shift goes on. THE TOUCH: the color drains, the view tilts and closes, the heartbeat slows, then THE CREW DRAGS YOU OUT

items.section: 13. Round three: the cradle, rebuilt
items.claim: From the fourth draw the settle wears thin: the gold drifts, the animal twitches (the ring shivers first), its eyes brighten

items.section: 13. Round three: the cradle, rebuilt
